thread:
anya: noticed negative cache credits on tenant cost card this AM. quick repro: session warmed prefetch_kv=100 on model=redwood-lite, router later fell back mid-stream and console shows credit across all tokens, making per-model econ negative.

miguel: can you paste a minimal repro snippet? likely attribution lacks token offsets so billing applies full prefetch credit.

anya: ```
session=abc-1001
start_model=redwood-lite
prefetch_kv=100
tokens_total=150
fallback_at=112
fallback_model=redwood-small
```

lina: we currently emit route_handoff timestamp but not a token index. two small fixes: emit handoff_token_index in a telemetry event, or emit span markers. telemetry event is lower blast radius.

product-sam: UX needs: 1) "why negative" drilldown showing routing spans + raw events, 2) a confidence badge when heuristics are used (e.g., "est. ±10% (heuristic)").

miguel: billing-side proposal: prorate prefetch credit to tokens < handoff_index; tokens after handoff get no prefetch credit. fallback for legacy routers: estimate index using timestamps + avg tokens/sec and mark as estimated.

lina: plan: router emits session_handoff {session_id, handoff_token_index, prefetch_kv}. telemetry indexes into session_attribution table. billing joins tokenized usage to that table and reconciles nightly. console shows provisional numbers until reconcile completes.

sre-bot: deploy-bot: canary for router-prefetch-metadata -> 2/4 hosts updated :rocket:

anya: i'll add an integration vector with handoff inside a chunk (non-aligned index) to make sure prorating works.

product-sam: add a tiny timeline sparkline per-session on the tenant card and a tooltip that exposes the raw event ids for support forwarding. also gate behind FF.

ops-bot: incident created INC-4212 for initial spike; monitoring alert M-820 will mute once reconciled numbers stable.

miguel: estimate: router event + indexer = 1d, billing reconcile job = 2d, console UX + tooltip = 1d. ship phased behind FF; P0 is removing negative savings from top-10 tenants.

lina: i'll draft a short support runbook explaining provisional vs reconciled and how to collect handoff event ids.

anya: thanks all, will open PR with test vectors and link to rollout doc. closing when PR + FF validated. :thumbsup:
